In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 319 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.2 per 1,000 residents, the 32nd highest rate of Bristol's 34 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (31), vehicle crime (14), burglary (9); the evening/night score by violent crime (22), public order (6), anti social behaviour (6). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze safe?

Wandroz currently rates Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze in Bristol as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bristol at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze safe at night?

At night, Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bristol. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Westbury-on-Trym and Henleaze's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
